generator_scope: Combined k6 and Python observer job container; not isolated k6 CPU
engine_scope: Owned engine container and its ancestors; constraints are outcomes, not generator-validity failures
database_scope: Read-only activity counts for the owned role and cumulative statistics for the trial database. Statistics can lag and include observer overhead. No database host CPU or memory headroom claim.
work_window: Scheduled release through the later of final recipient observation and final request return. Batch terminal bookkeeping remains separate.
